seed_note: No randomness; every reported finite range is exhaustively enumerated.

scope.finite_feasibility: all 3^7 labeled subsets of the 7 words over {a,b} of length at most 2; candidate partition {{a},{b}}
scope.generated_languages: all 2-block partitions of {a,b,c}; for each block, all finite languages that are subsets of block words of length at most 2
scope.generated_sample: all words over {a,b,c} of length at most 4 that touch both true blocks, labeled by the complete generator
scope.witness_check: complete generator labels on words through length 6; all context words x,y over {a,b,c} each of length at most 2

finite_feasibility_boolean_exhaustion.result: projection criterion agrees with independent Boolean assignment enumeration

theory_solver_independent_crosscheck.result: partition_solver matches the independent Boolean assignment oracle, with and without graph pruning

targeted_solver_witness_cases.result: forward/reverse swap and insertion-rescue witnesses are extracted with valid payloads; infeasible case agrees with oracle

known_generator_exhaustion.local_language_domain: all subsets of block words of length at most 2 (finite regular languages)
known_generator_exhaustion.sample_words: all words of length at most 4 touching both true blocks; labels from complete generator
known_generator_exhaustion.witness_contexts: all x,y over abc of length at most 2 each; labels queried from complete generator
assertions: every inferred edge lies inside the true generator block
graph components refine the true partition
r >= k for every enumerated generator
if r == k, graph components equal the true partition
the true partition is feasible for every generated finite sample

claim_limitations: A finite sample can be feasible under multiple incomparable partitions and multiple different target languages.
Pairwise projection/merge checks can miss a constraint that appears only when three letters form one block.
Graph soundness follows from the witness theorem; this bounded enumeration is corroboration, not the general proof.

r=k exact recovery is conditional on a true noise-free k-block target in the model class and correctly labeled witnesses for every graph edge used; complete-generator labels are used only in the generator audit, not required by the solver theorem.
